chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Al-Hasan ibn Zur'arah, from his father, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who married a woman according to her ruling (of the dowry). He said: 'Her ruling does not exceed the dowry of the women of the Household of Muhammad (peace be upon them) by more than twelve ounces and a nan, which is the weight of five hundred dirhams of silver.'
I said: 'What do you think if he married her according to his ruling and she accepted it?' He said: 'Whatever he ruled regarding something, it is valid for her, whether little or much.'

I said: 'How is it that you did not validate her ruling upon him, but validated his ruling upon her?' He said: 'Because he made her the ruler (arbiter), so she could not exceed what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established and married his wives upon, so I returned her ruling to the Sunnah.'
And because she is the one who made him the ruler, and placed the matter of the dowry in his hands, and accepted his ruling in that, so she must accept his ruling, whether little or much.'

key_terms.حُكْمِهَا: Her ruling/decision (referring to the wife determining the dowry)
key_terms.نِسَاءِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The women of the Household of Muhammad (peace be upon them)

ai.seo_question: What is the maximum limit for a wife's self-determined dowry if the husband allows it?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) establishes a nuanced asymmetry in marital contracts: if a wife is granted authority to set her own dowry, it is capped at the prophetic standard of twelve ounces and a nan of silver to prevent excess, reflecting the Sunnah of the Ahl al-Bayt. Conversely, if the husband sets the amount and she consents, her acceptance is binding regardless of whether it is modest or substantial, as she has voluntarily submitted to his judgment. This ruling highlights the jurisprudential principle that the party granting authority is bound by the established norm, while the party accepting authority is bound by their consent.
